#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""LAIS Setup Script - Creates all source files for Linux AI Security Toolkit"""
import base64, os, sys

FILES = {
    "run_lais.py": "",
    "ai_model.py": "",
    "prompt_attack.py": "",
    "shadow_detector.py": "",
    "owasp_scanner.py": "",
    "nist_ai_rmf.py": "",
    "demo_environments.py": "",
    "report_generator.py": "",
    "requirements.txt": "bWF0cGxvdGxpYgpweXlhbWwKUGlsbG93Cg==",
}

def main():
    print("[*] Setting up LAIS - Linux AI Security Toolkit...")
    for fname, b64 in FILES.items():
        content = base64.b64decode(b64).decode("utf-8")
        with open(fname, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
            f.write(content)
        size = len(content)
        print("    [+] {:<40s} {:,} bytes".format(fname, size))
    print("")
    print("[+] Setup complete! {} files created.".format(len(FILES)))
    print("[*] Run: python run_lais.py --demo")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
